tracks.title: Hold The Line Open
tracks.subject: a long-distance call
tracks.caption: An indie rock band recorded live in one room — drums, bass and two electric guitars, one clean and arpeggiated, one with light overdrive. A raspy male voice sings close-miked and conversational in the verses and pushes into a shout on the chorus. Bone-dry drums with audible room bleed, no reverb on the vocal, tape saturation on the bus. Driving, 132 BPM, E minor. Urgent, unresolved.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Guitars]

[Verse 1]
Eight hours and a bad connection
You say my name and then it cuts
I hold the phone against the window
Like the glass could help somehow

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't hang up yet
Don't hang up yet

[Chorus]
Hold the line open
Even if there's nothing on it
I'd rather hear you breathing wrong
Than hear the room without you in it

[Verse 2]
You're asleep before my morning
I'm asleep before your night
We trade the same four hours over
Like they're all we're allowed

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
I counted every time it dropped
I stopped at forty-one
I kept redialing anyway

[Chorus]
Hold the line open
Even if there's nothing on it
I'd rather hear you breathing wrong
Than hear the room without you in it

[Outro]
Still here
Still here

tracks.title: Lampu Kedai Tutup
tracks.subject: closing up a roadside shop
tracks.caption: Malaysian slow rock — rock kapak. A four-piece band: heavy slow backbeat, a bass that walks under the chorus, a clean rhythm guitar and a lead guitar that answers every vocal line and takes a long melodic solo. A male tenor sings with a wide vibrato and belts the chorus at full voice, the way 90s Malaysian slow rock ballads do. Tape saturation, close-miked vocals, plate reverb on the guitars. Slow and heavy, 74 BPM, A minor.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Lead Guitar]

[Verse 1]
Lampu kedai sudah kupadam
Kerusi terbalik di atas meja
Jalan ini sunyi jam tiga pagi
Hanya aku dan bayang sendiri

[Pre-Chorus]
Dua puluh tahun aku di sini
Hari ini hari terakhir

[Chorus]
Biar gelap, aku tak lari
Biar habis, aku tak menyesal
Setiap pinggan yang pernah kubasuh
Ada nama anak-anakku di situ

[Verse 2]
Orang kata zaman dah berubah
Kedai baru buka depan sana
Aku tak marah, aku cuma penat
Penat yang tak boleh dibayar

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
Kalau esok aku lalu sini
Dan kedai ini jadi milik orang
Aku akan berhenti sekejap
Dan ucap terima kasih

[Chorus]
Biar gelap, aku tak lari
Biar habis, aku tak menyesal
Setiap pinggan yang pernah kubasuh
Ada nama anak-anakku di situ

[Outro]
Selamat tinggal
Selamat tinggal

tracks.title: 末班車還有人
tracks.subject: the last train
tracks.caption: A Mandarin pop ballad. Grand piano carries the verses alone, a string section enters at the pre-chorus and swells under the chorus. A male baritone sings restrained and close-miked in the verses, then opens up with full chest voice on the chorus. Warm analog saturation, plate reverb on the vocal, no drums until the second verse where brushed kit enters softly. Slow, 68 BPM, F major. Melancholy but warm, not bleak.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Piano]

[Verse 1]
月台的燈比人還多
最後一班車慢慢靠站
你說再等等
等到什麼我沒有問

[Pre-Chorus]
廣播念完最後一站
風從隧道那頭吹過來

[Chorus]
末班車還有人
只是不再有你
我把座位空著
像留一個從不會來的約

[Verse 2]
手機亮了又暗了
是廣告不是你
窗外的城市倒著走
我也想跟著退回去

[Bridge - strings]
如果那年我留下
如果那晚我說出口
這班車會不會
就不用開這麼久

[Chorus]
末班車還有人
只是不再有你
我把座位空著
像留一個從不會來的約

[Outro]
門要關了
我還坐著

tracks.title: 縣道邊的加油站
tracks.subject: a highway petrol station
tracks.caption: Chinese folk rock, a four-piece band tracked live in one room. An acoustic guitar strums under a lightly overdriven electric that answers each vocal line, bass walking, dry drums with audible room bleed. A raspy male voice, close-miked, half-speaks the verses and opens into a rough shout on the chorus. No reverb on the vocal, tape saturation on the bus. 126 BPM, D major. Restless, road-worn.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Acoustic Guitar]

[Verse 1]
縣道兩百公里
只有這一盞燈亮著
老闆娘在看重播的球賽
我加了三十塊的油

[Pre-Chorus]
往前是還沒去過的地方
往後是不想回去的地方

[Chorus]
我站在中間抽完一根煙
風把塑膠袋吹過馬路
沒有人問我要去哪裡
這大概就是自由

[Verse 2]
手機只剩一格訊號
地圖轉了兩圈定不下來
收音機在放二十年前的歌
我跟著哼了一句

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
如果這條路沒有盡頭
那我也不用急著到

[Chorus]
我站在中間抽完一根煙
風把塑膠袋吹過馬路
沒有人問我要去哪裡
這大概就是自由

[Outro]
再一根就走
再一根就走

tracks.title: 霓虹還沒關
tracks.subject: a city that never turns its lights off
tracks.caption: 80s Japanese-style city pop sung in Mandarin. Funky sixteenth-note rhythm guitar, a Rhodes electric piano comping jazzy chords, slap bass, warm analog synth pads and a short synth-brass hit on the chorus. A husky female lead sings smoky and laid-back, sitting behind the beat, with light stacked harmonies on the hook. Warm analog saturation, wide stereo image, gated reverb on the snare. 104 BPM, E-flat major. Nostalgic, urban, night-drive.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes & Guitar]

[Verse 1]
計程車的頂燈在下雨裡發光
我沒有招手 只是站著看
玻璃上的城市在流
流成一條發亮的河

[Pre-Chorus]
十二點過後這裡才真正醒來

[Chorus]
霓虹還沒關
我就還不想回家
燈一盞一盞替我說著
那些我說不出口的話

[Verse 2]
便利商店的音樂循環第三遍
店員在擦同一塊玻璃
我們都在等一個
不會來的人

[Synth Solo]

[Chorus]
霓虹還沒關
我就還不想回家
燈一盞一盞替我說著
那些我說不出口的話

[Outro]
再走一條街
再走一條街

tracks.title: 梨園未散
tracks.subject: an opera troupe after the audience leaves
tracks.caption: Chinese guofeng orchestral pop. Guzheng arpeggios open alone, erhu carries the countermelody, dizi answers, a Chinese percussion section — bangu and cymbals — marks the chorus, all over a modern string arrangement. A bright female soprano sings forward-placed with xiqiang opera ornamentation, sliding into notes and running melismas at the ends of phrases. Studio-polished, wide stereo image, long reverb tails on the erhu. 76 BPM, A minor pentatonic. Elegant, faded grandeur.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Guzheng]

[Verse 1]
戲台的燈一盞盞暗了
觀眾席空得像退潮
我還穿著那身水袖
沒有人叫我卸妝

[Pre-Chorus]
鑼鼓停了 我的心還在走板

[Chorus]
梨園未散 是我不肯下台
唱了一輩子別人的悲歡
輪到自己 卻沒有詞
只剩一個轉身的身段

[Verse 2]
師父說戲比天大
我信了四十年
如今天塌下來
也沒人看見

[Erhu Solo]

[Bridge]
若有來世還學這行
我想演一次不用哭的角

[Chorus]
梨園未散 是我不肯下台
唱了一輩子別人的悲歡
輪到自己 卻沒有詞
只剩一個轉身的身段

[Outro]
燈全暗了
我才謝幕

tracks.title: 凌晨四點的訊息
tracks.subject: a message typed and never sent
tracks.caption: Trip hop in Mandarin. A dusty, slightly swung breakbeat with a heavy sub bass, muted Rhodes chords, a single detuned synth line and continuous vinyl crackle underneath. A soft female alto whispers the verses very close to the mic and half-sings the chorus, doubled an octave up. Lo-fi intimacy, tape hiss, no bright highs. 82 BPM, C minor. Still, late, unresolved.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Breakbeat & Vinyl]

[Verse 1]
打了一段又刪掉
游標在那裡閃了很久
你的名字排在最上面
因為我從來沒往下滑過

[Pre-Chorus]
四點零七分
沒有人該在這個時間醒著

[Chorus]
我把想說的都打完了
然後一個字一個字刪回去
訊息從來沒有送出
可是我確實說過了

[Verse 2]
窗外有第一班公車
世界要開始了
我把手機蓋在胸口
讓它跟著我一起睡

[Bridge]
如果哪天你也在四點醒來
你會不會也打了又刪

[Chorus]
我把想說的都打完了
然後一個字一個字刪回去
訊息從來沒有送出
可是我確實說過了

[Outro]
刪掉

tracks.title: 夜班
tracks.subject: working the night shift
tracks.caption: Mandarin trap. Deep bouncy 808 sub bass with slides, fast rolling triplet hi-hats, a sparse dark piano motif, no live drums. A male voice delivers a rhythmic sing-rap flow, laid-back behind the beat, with doubled ad-libs answering each line and a sung hook. Clean modern mixing, punchy low end, tight and dry. 140 BPM, F-sharp minor. Tense, nocturnal, working-class.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(夜班 夜班)

[Verse 1]
十一點打卡 六點下班
電梯裡只有我跟保全
他問我吃了沒 我說還沒
他說我也是

[Hook]
城市睡了我還醒著
醒著的人都在算錢
算到天亮還是不夠
不夠就再上一個夜班

[Verse 2]
手機借了三個平台
每個都說利息很低
我算過了 加起來不低
可是我沒得選

[Hook]
城市睡了我還醒著
醒著的人都在算錢
算到天亮還是不夠
不夠就再上一個夜班

[Bridge - spoken]
我媽問我累不累
我說不累

[Outro]
(再一個夜班)
(再一個夜班)

tracks.title: 慢一點也可以
tracks.subject: a slow Sunday morning
tracks.caption: Neo-soul in Mandarin. A stripped trio — Rhodes electric piano playing extended jazz voicings, brushed drums, upright double bass walking loosely — with a muted trumpet answering in the second verse. A husky female lead sings conversationally, runs melismas at the ends of lines, and opens from a whisper into a full belt on the last chorus. Warm analog saturation, plate reverb, close-miked and unhurried. 88 BPM, B-flat major. Warm, generous, domestic.

這些聲音我以前嫌吵
現在覺得剛剛好

[Trumpet Solo]

慢一點也可以
世界不會因為我們遲到就塌
你睡到幾點都行
我把太陽留在窗簾外面等

再睡一下

tracks.title: 潮水記得
tracks.subject: a tide coming back in
tracks.caption: Post-rock, largely instrumental. Two tremolo-picked electric guitars build over three minutes from a single clean arpeggio to a wall of delayed and overdriven sound, bass swelling underneath, drums entering with mallets and ending with full crashes. Wordless layered humming floats above the middle section; a single sung line arrives only in the last chorus. Cavernous reverb tails, very wide stereo image, no close vocal. 72 BPM, G major. Patient, building, finally bright.

tracks.title: 把燈留給你
tracks.subject: leaving a light on for someone
tracks.caption: Gospel soul sung in Mandarin. Hammond organ with a rotating speaker, upright piano, tambourine on the backbeat, hand claps, bass and a live drum kit. A deep male bass voice leads with warm sustained phrasing and a full choir answers every line in call and response, building to stacked harmonies and ad-libs over the final chorus, with a key change into the last repeat. Recorded in a live room with natural bleed and gospel-room reverb. 96 BPM, A-flat major. Communal, rising, hopeful.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Organ]

[Verse 1]
你走的那天沒有說幾點回
我就沒有問
只是把玄關那盞燈
換成了不會燒壞的

[Pre-Chorus]
(留著) 留著
(等著) 等著

[Chorus]
我把燈留給你
你什麼時候回來都看得見路
這條巷子很黑
可是我這一段是亮的

[Verse 2]
鄰居問我電費貴不貴
我說貴
他說那你還開
我說我還開

[Bridge - Choir]
(還開著) 還開著
(還亮著) 還亮著

[Chorus - key change]
我把燈留給你
你什麼時候回來都看得見路
這條巷子很黑
可是我這一段是亮的

[Outro]
一直亮著
一直亮著

tracks.title: 電波裡的你
tracks.subject: a radio station that went off air
tracks.caption: Synthpop in Mandarin. Analog synth bass, a bright arpeggiator running through the verses, warm pad chords, a drum machine with a gated snare and no live drums. A young male tenor sings clean and polished, lifting into an airy falsetto on the hook, with a vocoder doubling the last line. Crisp modern mixing, wide stereo image, shimmering highs. 118 BPM, D major. Bright, slightly melancholy, retro-futurist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Arpeggiator]

[Verse 1]
那個頻率現在只剩雜訊
我還是每天轉到那裡
你說過的晚安在某個地方
應該還在往外走

[Pre-Chorus]
光走了那麼遠都還在
聲音應該也可以

[Chorus]
電波裡的你
沒有變老也沒有離開
只是走得比較遠
遠到我這裡收不到

[Verse 2]
電台頂樓的天線鏽了
他們說沒有人聽了
可是我聽
我一直都在聽

[Synth Solo]

[Chorus - falsetto]
電波裡的你
沒有變老也沒有離開
只是走得比較遠
遠到我這裡收不到

[Outro - vocoder]
晚安
晚安
